Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.inbound

Interface EvaluatePromptsUseCase

All Known Implementing Classes:
PromptEvaluationService
public interface EvaluatePromptsUseCase
Inbound port — drive prompt evaluation and comparison workflows.

The implementation lives in domain/service and orchestrates calls to AiSummarizationPort, AiEvaluationPort, and persistence ports. The web layer calls this interface; it never touches the service class directly.

    • evaluate

      EvaluationResult evaluate(String variantId, List<String> articleIds, String topic, NewsletterTone tone)
      Run a single evaluation: summarize the given articles using the specified prompt variant, then score the output with the AI evaluator.
      Parameters:
      variantId - the prompt variant to evaluate

      tone - the tone for summarization
      Returns:
      the full evaluation result including section output and scores

    • compare

      ComparisonResult compare(List<String> variantIds, List<String> articleIds, String topic, NewsletterTone tone)
      Run a side-by-side comparison: evaluate the same articles against multiple prompt variants and group the results.
      Parameters:
      variantIds - IDs of the variants to compare (minimum 2)
      articleIds - IDs of articles to use as shared input
      topic - the topic for summarization
      tone - the tone for summarization
      Returns:
      a comparison result grouping all individual evaluations
